# Noise-Rate-Activated Sensing

> Rate diversity changes the optimal precision law of quantum sensing under a shared fixed unknown transverse error direction. The scientific account distinguishes local information, global minimax risk, and exact stopped-channel guarantees.

## Shared learning route
- [Learning entrypoint](learning/README.md): One reader-independent route through the project.
- [30 milestones](learning/MILESTONES.md): M01–M13 develop the background; M14–M30 connect the research mechanisms and complete scientific meaning. Each target includes dependencies and sources.
- [Common anchor bridge](learning/ANCHOR.md): Rivas–Huelga, Open Quantum Systems: An Introduction, arXiv:1104.5242v2, shared with Markovian Resolution. Source sections, notation, rate conventions and locally supplied estimation bridges.
- [Worked tutorial](learning/TUTORIAL.md): Ramsey likelihood, parity records, nuisance projection, the principal finite-strength global route, and separate Markovian examples and temporal comparisons.

Use the milestones for dependency order and the bridge for source translation. Each sister retains its own 30 project-specific milestones with a coordinated common foundation. One educational anchor does not replace primary-source attribution. These shared pages contain no personal assessment history or coaching contract.

## Scientific entry points
- [Scientific route](science/README.md): Dependency-ordered topic map of the full scientific account.
- [Overview](README.md): Central results, scope, reading routes, and purpose/contact.
- [Scientific synthesis](science/interpretation.md): Principal microscopic argument, supporting Markovian results, shared-result ownership, claim-to-proof map and scientific scope.
- [Model](science/model.md): Allowed controls, shared nuisance, full Fisher pooling, charged time, and parameter normalization.
- [Local theorems](science/precision_bounds.md): All-strategy fixed-rate converse, optimal selectable-setting coefficient, preset attainment, and independent-axis bound.
- [Global precision](science/global_precision.md): Same-metric minimax comparison, van Trees lower bounds valid for biased estimators, and matching global scalings.
- [Preset protocols](science/preset_protocols.md): Balanced echo, calibration penalty, recorded rate randomization, unknown-rate blocks, and finite-time local certificates.
- [Stopped sensing](science/stopped_sensing.md): Exact Ramsey channel, first-passage law, deadline accounting, and global achievability.
- [Physical scope](science/physical_scope.md): Collision and stochastic models, coherent-access distinction, signal shifts, and finite-cadence local result.
- [Microscopic sensing](science/microscopic_sensing.md): Exact bounded-collision instrument and attainable local coefficient; companion complete-record error and bounded-loss comparison.
- [Microscopic precision](science/microscopic_precision.md): All-controls fixed-coupling converse, matching recovery coefficient, and optimal two-coupling coefficient for boundary-only controls. With n cells and at most n−1 total contacts, at most m inside-cell contacts give optimal local information of order h²(n+m²), for fixed g,h. These local coefficients remain distinct from global risk constants.
- [Residual dephasing](science/residual_dephasing.md): Linear asymptotic ceiling from parallel noise and an exact finite-time advantage window for the specified readout.
- [Microscopic identifiability](science/microscopic_identifiability.md): Exact nuisance-independent three-outcome likelihood, an explicit sufficient frequency band, and uniform finite-budget calibration risk and confidence bounds. A calibration prefix counts its final early readout. The companion clock-alias obstruction limits boundary-only identification on broad bands.
- [Microscopic global precision](science/microscopic_global_precision.md): Optimal worst-case risk Θ(n⁻¹) at either one fixed positive coupling and Θ(n⁻²) with two couplings, on one suitable fixed nonshrinking band. A curved nuisance path supplies the adaptive converse; exact retained even records supply attainment. Hardware, cell clock and physical compensation remain fixed.
- [Recorded-phase estimation](science/recorded_phase_estimation.md): Canonical global upper-bound method shared with the companion temporal constructions. Uniform record gates, conditional inversion of actual nonlinear phase functions, paid coarse calibration, nested intervals, tapered repetitions and deterministic budgets. The two-state gate permits a zero flip probability at compensation.
- [Companion global contact law](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Markovian-Resolution-Limit/blob/main/science/global_contact_precision.md): At one fixed coupling, risk is of order 1/[h²(n+m²)] with at most m inside-cell and n−1 total contacts, on a suitable fixed band. The attaining temporal menu and the all-adaptive-contact converse are separate arguments.
- [Companion timing precision](https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Markovian-Resolution-Limit/blob/main/science/timing_precision.md): A supplied known fixed pulse displacement retains quadratic global order with a plain/pulsed-cell menu. Hidden independent two-point jitter of fixed nonzero amplitude gives inverse-time global risk for the specified plain/jittered-one-pulse menu, despite quadratic local information at compensation. This restricted-menu converse does not cover arbitrary further interior controls or coupling selection.
- [Related work](references/RELATED_WORK.md): Claim-level primary-source comparisons, inherited global-phase methods, general comb frameworks, paid repetition/calibration precedents and stronger access models.
- [Bibliography](references/references.bib): Machine-readable references.

## Verification and maintenance
- [Reproducibility](verification/README.md): Commands, check coverage, numerical examples, and evidence-table definitions.
- [Stopped calculations](src/nras.py): Algebra, control speed, timing laws, and event simulator.
- [Preset calculations](src/preset.py): Complete Fisher matrices, calibration laws, and labelled-design coefficients.
- [Risk and dephasing calculations](src/risk.py): Global lower bounds, fixed-rate upper scaling, and dephased preset information.
- [Stopped tests](tests/test_nras.py): Symbolic identities, trajectories, optimization, and deadline-aware samples.
- [Preset tests](tests/test_preset.py): Echo trajectories, likelihood finite differences, rate uncertainty, and randomization bounds.
- [Risk tests](tests/test_risk.py): Prior and bound ingredients, estimator check, mixed-state likelihood, resource identities, and deterministic evidence regeneration.
- [Learning checks](tests/test_learning.py): Finite checks of tutorial examples, probability readout, exposure accounting, and source-rate normalization.
- [Evidence tables](results/evidence.json): Exact formula evaluations generated by scripts/reproduce_evidence.py; bounds are not exact risks.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Authorized repository, scientific invariants, and maintenance workflow.

Treat proof documents as the claim definitions, not test counts as universal evidence. Pool complete Fisher matrices before eliminating a shared nuisance. Preset rate choice is not feedback-free when recovery follows errors. Distinguish local information, global risk, and exact output independence; charge every repetition and failure. A record-dependent terminal measurement basis does not retune the physical compensation. The microscopic global bands are fixed independently of the budget, and optimal global constants and maximal bandwidth are not claimed. Neither arbitrary-noise fault tolerance nor an unrestricted timing-error converse is asserted. Bath-output access, indefinite causal order, and a coherent unknown-axis drive are outside the central model. Do not infer priority or experimental demonstration from finite checks.
